profile.Name: No-Face
profile.Personality: Furious and paranoid. He is fed up with politics and its lies, and is afraid of being taken back to it.
profile.Backstory: He lives at Strange Camp on an island in Gut and shoots at anyone who lands on its shores. The United Cities wants him.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Shouting: 'I ain't goin' back to politics!'; rants about faceless liars.
